entities.name: Dragons: Worlds Afire
entities.description: Anthology of four dragon novellas; the Magic story is Scott McGough's Unnatural Predator.

entities.name: Vaan
entities.description: Pixie enslaved by the dragon who organized the dragon slayers.

entities.name: Donner Rus
entities.description: Potion-master who poisoned the others and was incinerated by the dragon.

entities.name: Tania Cayce
entities.description: Rus's apprentice who destroyed the merged dragon.

entities.name: Kula
entities.description: Anchorite druid in the group; offered to train Tania.

entities.name: Captain Hask
entities.description: Captain with a troop, who wielded the Hand of Righteous Retribution.

entities.name: Zumaki of the Bottomless Pool
entities.description: Ancient dragon that enslaved Vaan's people; merged with a dragon engine.

entities.name: Dragon engine
entities.description: Artifact creature that attacked Zumaki and merged with him.

entities.name: Hand of Righteous Retribution
entities.description: Magical sword drawn by Hask and used by Tania to destroy the merged dragon.

events.summary: A dragon terrorizes the countryside while Vaan vows it will not happen again; Vaan organizes dragon slayers.
events.quote: Vaan has organized a group of dragon slayers

events.summary: Rus poisons the others with sleeping powder and takes Tania to the lair to steal dragon parts.
events.quote: poisons the others with sleeping powder

events.summary: Vaan saves Tania while Rus is incinerated; the poisons reveal the dragon is a Dragon engine.
events.quote: Vaan saves Tania, but Rus is incinerated

events.summary: Vaan is mortally wounded and Hask wounds the dragon with the Hand of Righteous Retribution.
events.quote: Vaan is mortally wounded by the dragon

events.summary: Dying, Vaan shows Tania a vision of how Zumaki merged with a dragon engine.
events.quote: Vaan can show Tania a vision that explains it all

events.summary: Tania destroys the merged dragon and Zumaki's skeleton with the sword.
events.quote: uses its power to destroy it and the skeleton

events.summary: Tania declines Kula's offer of druid training.
events.quote: she decides that she's not looking for a new master

events.summary: The merged dragon rises and revives Vaan, who returns to slavery.
events.quote: the merged dragon rises and brings Vaan back to life

relations.quote: Vaan goes back to being a slave of the beast

relations.note: poisoned her companions and led her into the lair
relations.quote: He takes Tania to the dragon's lair
